title: Peru's coast and Amazon: Unit Review
goal: Review the Humboldt Current, viceregal Lima, Afro-Peruvian heritage, Peruvian food and Iquitos, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: formal cause connectors, the ser passive, aun cuando, passive and impersonal se, regrets and reproaches

items: I can review what I learned about Peru's coast and Amazon, from the Humboldt Current to Iquitos.
I can use *debido a*, the *ser* passive, *aun cuando*, passive and impersonal *se*, and regrets with *haber*.
I can put events from 1535 to 2023 in order.
I can say who says what when a matter is disputed.
I can explain a cause formally with *debido a* and *a raíz de* + noun (review).
I can say what was founded or proclaimed with the passive (*fue fundada*).
I can grant a point with *aun cuando* + indicative or subjunctive (review).
I can choose between passive and impersonal *se*.
I can express regrets and reproaches with *debería haber* + participle.
